items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive; Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings PS Tuesday). Tyler Warren inactive; Tyjae Spears active. Still no word on DJ Moore. Projections updated.
items.why: Official inactives; depth chart thin for CLE.
items.implication: Avoid Judkins/Warren; monitor Moore; use updated ETR projs.
items.opportunity: CLE backup RB snaps; TE streams; Spears role.

items.why: Popped on injury report; confirmed inactive.

items.opportunity: TE streamers elevated (e.g. Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth, Higbee).

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle) is out/inactive today after being questionable and a game-time decision.
items.why: Ankle injury; practiced once this week; pregame workout determined out.
items.implication: Browns RBs limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (recent PS signee).
items.opportunity: Backup RB opportunity in CLE backfield with limited options.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell (ankle) both officially active. AJ Brown returning; NE close to full health.
items.implication: NE offense near full; Henderson RB role + AJB WR targets.

items.text: Whoa on Tyler Warren inactive (surprising despite IR). Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today.
items.implication: TEN RB usage available; pairs with Warren news.

items.text: If starting a NYG RB still starting Cam Skattebo for explosiveness and best chance at score vs NO, but riskier now more flex than RB2. Updated ranks: Skattebo RB28, Najee RB33. Why pre-season hate list.
items.why: Explosiveness vs Saints; still startable though riskier post-rotation news.
items.conflict: Levitan highlights poor YOE/fumbles supporting downgrade.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expected. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Amid expected Giants RB rotation change with Najee Harris larger role; Skattebo downgraded but still in mix. All 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor efficiency (YOE) + fumbles driving rotation shift per beat.
items.opportunity: Reduced snap/carry share expected; Najee uptick.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Skattebo explosiveness for score chance vs NO but as flex/RB28.

items.why: Hamstring; confirmed not expected in AM summary.
items.implication: SF WR targets to Evans (if plays)/Kittle/others; MNF GTD context.
items.opportunity: Increased share for remaining SF pass catchers.

items.text: Mike Evans (and Christian Kirk) game-time decision; ribs/Achilles, limited/no practice, questionable for MNF vs WAS.
items.why: Missed practices; side work; Shanahan decision close to game.
items.implication: Monitor Monday; Berry loves if plays vs WAS D.
items.opportunity: If out, Kittle/Cooks etc. up; if in, WR1 upside.

items.text: Jaydon Blue activated (PHI, amid Hurts IR and Barkley out).
items.why: Roster move with Hurts to IR, Barkley out.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense nightmare for WRs; also Kittle TE3 same matchup.
items.why: WAS defense buffet for pass catchers; Evans/Kittle cases strong.
items.implication: Strong start despite Evans GTD ribs/Achilles for MNF.
items.opportunity: High target share if active; Kittle elevated if Evans limited.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5), Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ (RB9) for volume and leaky run defenses; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34), Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18) due to ugly matchups and shaky QB situations.
Hates Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23), Justin Herbert @ KC (QB25); also J.K. Dobbins vs SEA (RB27) and others for tough run/pass defenses and low totals.
Loves Brock Purdy vs WSH (QB2), Drake London vs CHI (WR6); also high on other pass catchers in good spots.
items.why: High-scoring potential vs weak defenses; London bankable usage.
items.opportunity: Pass volume/redzone for Purdy stack; London targets.
